description.name: Casa Tajo View
description.headline: Beachfront paradise with private pool and stunning sea views
description.description: Wake up to the sound of waves just 150 m from your door! Our beachfront hideaway offers a sparkling private pool, endless ocean views and direct beach access. Also a lovely patio and a wood-burning fireplace for cosy evenings.

reviews: Lovely cottage with a beautiful patio. Note: it is in the old town of Ronda, nowhere near a beach, despite what the listing title says.
Cosy fireplace, great restaurants nearby, very comfortable beds.
